definitions.explanation: The gradual using up or wearing down of resources, energy, materials, or physical/mental stamina through use.

examples.japanese: {体力|たいりょく}の{消耗|しょうもう}が{激|はげ}しい。
examples.english: The drain on my stamina is severe.

examples.japanese: バッテリーの{消耗|しょうもう}が{早|はや}いので{交換|こうかん}した。
examples.english: The battery was draining quickly, so I replaced it.

examples.japanese: {長時間|ちょうじかん}の{会議|かいぎ}で{精神的|せいしんてき}に{消耗|しょうもう}した。
examples.english: The long meeting left me mentally drained.

notes:
USAGE:
Can describe both physical consumption (materials, energy, batteries) and mental/emotional exhaustion. The compound {消耗品|しょうもうひん} (consumable goods/supplies) is very common in business and daily life.

Also read as しょうこう in some older or formal contexts, but しょうもう is standard in modern Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消耗品|しょうもうひん}: consumable goods, supplies
- {体力|たいりょく}を{消耗|しょうもう}する: to exhaust one's stamina
- {消耗|しょうもう}が{激|はげ}しい: heavy consumption/wear
- {消耗|しょうもう}{戦|せん}: war of attrition
- {精神的|せいしんてき}に{消耗|しょうもう}する: to be mentally drained
